text:
maya: Quick follow-up from PM-2026-050 (routing + TLS retry surge). Summarizing owners + short ETAs so we can track. Root cause: control-plane reconcile thrash + DNS TTL shadowing + certificate rotation concurrency amplifying client retries.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: PM-2026-050 https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-050 :bookmark_tabs: 

akash: Owning DNS invalidation work. Plan: reduce canary TTL to 10s, add event-driven invalidation, and emit 'dns_invalidation_events' metric. ETA: 2026-06-10 18:00 UTC.

brett: I'll take the reconcile guardrails. Implement CAS (compare-and-swap) on route applies and add a temporary stop-reconcile toggle for canary pools. ETA for mitigation deploy: 2026-06-10 16:30 UTC.

sam: TLS side: region-2 had handshake spikes during rotation. I'll add jitter to rotation schedule, tighten cert cache invalidation, and backoff handshake retries aggressively. ETA: 2026-06-11 12:00 UTC.

leo: I'll run verification probes after brett's change and akash's invalidations. Probe targets: us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Probe command I'll use:
```
curl -sS -H "Host: api.redwood.internal" https://lb-probe.local/check -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```
Posting results to PM-2026-050 doc.

maria: Alerts/runbook follow-ups: adding metrics edge_tls_handshake_retry, dns_invalidation_failures, lb_reconcile_thrash. Composite alert: (lb_reconcile_thrash > 3 in 5m) OR (dns_invalidation_failures > 8 in 10m) => page networking-sre. ETA: 2026-06-10 20:00 UTC.

maya: Action list. Please confirm owners or reassign: 
- ACTION brett: reconcile CAS + stop-reconcile toggle 026-06-10 16:30 UTC
- ACTION akash: TTL reduce + invalidation hook + metric 026-06-10 18:00 UTC
- ACTION sam: cert-rotation jitter + handshake backoff 026-06-11 12:00 UTC
- ACTION leo: post-mitigation probe sweep + CSV results 026-06-10 23:00 UTC
- ACTION maria: add composite alerts + runbook snippet 026-06-10 20:00 UTC

brett: quick note 026-06-10 15:50 UTC: stop-reconcile flag merged to canary branch, rolling canary now.

akash: update 2026-06-10 17:40 UTC: TTL change pushed to canary DNS, invalidation events firing; initial shadow_count down ~85%.

leo: update 2026-06-10 23:15 UTC: probe sweep finished. No asymmetric routing observed; median p95 latency normal. Uploaded CSV to PM-2026-050.

sam: update 2026-06-11 11:45 UTC: rotation jitter + backoff rolled to region-2; handshake_retry down ~70%. Scheduling full rollout after lunch.

maria: update 2026-06-11 12:20 UTC: alerts added and tested. Runbook snippet: "If dns_invalidation_failures > 8 OR lb_reconcile_thrash > 3 => page networking-sre and post probe CSV to thread." Linked in PM-2026-050.

maya: thanks all. I'll convert to tickets and set a 48h recheck on recurrence patterns. Reopen thread if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
